title: Finance & Investment
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Has dominado el lenguaje de Wall Street. Entender de activos, pasivos y mercados financieros te pone en otro nivel profesional.

parts.visual:
Términos contables y corporativos: 
- Assets (Activos - lo que la empresa posee). 
- Liabilities (Pasivos - las deudas u obligaciones). 
- ROI (Return on Investment - Retorno de inversión). 
- Go public (Salir a bolsa - vender acciones al público). 
Ej: To go public, our assets must be greater than our liabilities.
parts.audio: Accounting and corporate terms. Assets are what the company owns. Liabilities are the debts or obligations. R O I stands for Return on Investment. Go public means to start selling shares to the general public on the stock market. For example: To go public, our assets must be greater than our liabilities.

parts.visual:
El Mercado: 
- Bear market (Mercado bajista / en caída). 
- Bull market (Mercado alcista / en crecimiento). 
- Stakeholder (Cualquier persona o grupo afectado por las decisiones de la empresa, no solo accionistas). 
Ej: In a bear market, stakeholders demand a clear strategy to protect their ROI.
parts.audio: The Market. A bear market is a market in decline. A bull market is a growing market. A stakeholder is anyone affected by the company's decisions, not just shareholders. For example: In a bear market, stakeholders demand a clear strategy to protect their R O I.

questions.question: The company's ____ include real estate, equipment, and cash. (Activos).
questions.explanation: Assets = activos (lo que posee la empresa).

questions.question: We need to pay off our ____ to improve our financial health. (Pasivos / Deudas).
What is the expected ____ on this marketing campaign? (Retorno de Inversión).
After 10 years of private growth, the startup decided to ____ public. (Salir a bolsa).
questions.explanation: Go public = salir a la bolsa de valores.

questions.question: During a ____ market, stock prices are falling and investors are pessimistic. (Mercado bajista).
questions.explanation: Bear market = mercado bajista (el oso ataca hacia abajo).

questions.question: In a ____ market, prices are rising and the economy is strong. (Mercado alcista).
questions.explanation: Bull market = mercado alcista (el toro ataca hacia arriba).

questions.question: Employees, customers, and investors are all ____ of the company. (Partes interesadas / afectados).
questions.explanation: Stakeholders = grupos de interés o partes afectadas.

questions.question: A ____ is a person who owns shares in a company. (Accionista).
questions.explanation: Shareholder = accionista (dueño de acciones). Todo shareholder es stakeholder, pero no al revés.

questions.question: When a company goes public, it offers an IPO. What does the 'I' stand for? (Oferta Pública INICIAL).
The company filed for ____ because it couldn't pay its debts. (Bancarrota).
questions.explanation: File for bankruptcy = declararse en bancarrota.

questions.question: If you buy shares, you hope they will pay a good ____ at the end of the year. (Dividendo).
questions.explanation: Dividend = dividendo (la parte de las ganancias que se reparte a los accionistas).

questions.question: We need to ____ our portfolio to minimize risk. (Diversificar).
The total amount of money a company receives from sales is its ____. (Ingresos).
questions.explanation: Revenue (o turnover) = ingresos totales antes de deducir gastos.

questions.question: Revenue minus expenses equals ____. (Ganancia neta / Beneficio).
A company's financial statement showing assets and liabilities is the balance ____. (Hoja de balance).
The money a business owes to its suppliers is called Accounts ____. (Cuentas por pagar).
The money owed TO a business by its customers is Accounts ____. (Cuentas por cobrar).
Our cash ____ is positive, meaning more money is coming in than going out. (Flujo).
We must calculate the ____ margin before setting the final price. (Margen de beneficio).
A sudden drop in stock prices caused a market ____. (Caída/Desplome).
questions.explanation: Market crash = desplome del mercado financiero.

questions.question: Company ____. (Activos con A plural)
Company ____. (Pasivos con L plural)
Return on Investment is ____. (Acrónimo 3 letras)
To ____ public. (Salir a bolsa con G)
A ____ market. (Mercado bajista con B)
A ____ market. (Mercado alcista con B)
All the ____. (Partes interesadas con S plural)
Total ____. (Ingresos con R)
File for ____. (Bancarrota con B)
Cash ____. (Flujo de caja con F)
